name: bbva.com.co
body: Every page has a title, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But plain http serves the site without redirecting.
lesson: Redirect every http request to https with one permanent 301, then add HSTS.
summary: The site's bot protection refused the plain read and headless Chrome while it carried the review tag; the page was analyzed in headless Chrome without the tag. Partial analysis: 19 of 19 linked pages answered with a bot check or a block, so the scores rest mostly on the start page. www.bbva.com.co scores 68 out of 100 (D). 5 checks fail now, 22 are at risk, and 22 pass. Fix first: tracking…

fix.title: Tracking starts before the visitor chooses
fix.evidence: A cookie banner was showing. Before any choice, Chromium from an EU address (Belgium) saw Criteo (5 requests), Adobe Analytics (5 requests), Microsoft Clarity (3 requests), Google Ads (2 requests), Meta Pixel (1 request), X Ads (1 request), Outbrain (1…
fix.fix: Hold every tag until consent, or set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads. Block third-party embeds until the visitor agrees.

fix.title: Plain http serves the site without redirecting
fix.evidence: http:// answered 403. Visitors who type the address stay unencrypted.
fix.fix: Redirect every http request to https with a 301, then add HSTS.

fix.title: Elements must have their visible text as part of their accessible name
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 5 elements on /, for example .lightbox--ready[target="_lightbox"][type="button"] and #content-cardsmodule_copy_copy-cardsmoduleparsys-card1-button. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Start the aria-label with the words that are visible on the control.

fix.title: The layout shifts by 0.423 while loading
fix.evidence: Measured once in Chromium from an EU address (Belgium) with no network throttling. A phone on mobile data will be slower. Good is under 0.1.
fix.fix: Reserve space for images, ads, embeds, and late banners.

fix.title: 2 cookies are sent without Secure
fix.evidence: Without Secure: ak_bmsc, bm_sz. Set on /.
fix.fix: Set Secure on every cookie, and HttpOnly plus SameSite=Lax on session cookies.

fix.title: Tracking tags load with no consent tool in the page
fix.evidence: Google Analytics 4, Google Ads, Meta Pixel, X Pixel, Microsoft Ads UET, Microsoft Clarity, Adobe Analytics appear in the HTML and no consent platform or Google Consent Mode default was found. In the EU, the UK, Brazil, and Colombia this is a legal exposure.
fix.fix: Add a consent platform and set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads.

works.title: AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
HSTS is sent with a long max-age
The start page declares its language
The largest element paints in 0.5 s
Every page has a meta description
Structured data parses and carries the expected properties
